texts.bulletin: Harvest disruption risk in City of Tuguegarao due to rainfall of 57.7 mm/24h. HARVEST ADVISORY — City of Tuguegarao

4. Document areas where harvest was deferred for scheduling follow-up.

texts.bulletin: Harvest disruption risk in Luna due to rainfall of 57.7 mm/24h. HARVEST ADVISORY — Luna

3. Issue tarpaulin assistance where needed.
4. Document areas where harvest was deferred for scheduling follow-up.

texts.bulletin: Harvest disruption risk in Roxas due to rainfall of 27.4 mm/24h. Farmers in ripening or harvesting stages should: (1) Defer combine harvester deployment to avoid bogging; (2) Protect cut stalks from further wetting; (3) Prioritize mechanical drying over sun-drying for collected grain. Postharvest drying risk is ELEVATED. Coordinate with DA mechanization service providers for mobile dryer access.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: Rain risk for harvest in Roxas. Defer harvest, use mechanical dryer if available. Call MAO for help.
texts.lgu:
HARVEST ADVISORY — Roxas
Rainfall of 27.4 mm may disrupt ongoing harvest operations.
Recommended actions:
1. Advise farmers to assess field conditions before deploying machinery.
2. Coordinate with RCEF mechanization pool for mobile dryer deployment.
3. Issue tarpaulin assistance where needed.
4. Document areas where harvest was deferred for scheduling follow-up.

3. Issue tarpaulin assistance where needed.
4. Document areas where harvest was deferred for scheduling follow-up.
